typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	DestDBNAME as string,
	DestSCHEMANAME as string,
	DestTABLENAME as string,
	StrCallDestTable as string,
	StrDestSCHEMANAME as string,
	StrDestTABLENAME as string,
	OutFileName as string
}
source(output(
		RPT_DT as date,
		PLTFM_TXT as string,
		ENVRN_TXT as string,
		DATABASENAME as string,
		CREATE_DTTM as timestamp,
		LAST_UPD_DTTM as timestamp,
		LAST_ALTER_DT as date,
		LAST_DCL_DT as date,
		LAST_DDL_DT as date,
		LAST_DML_DT as date,
		LAST_DQL_DT as date,
		LAST_OTHER_SQL_DT as date,
		TABLENAME as string,
		CREATORNAME as string,
		CREATOR_FULL_NAME as string,
		CREATOR_EMAIL_ADDR as string,
		CREATE_DT as date,
		CURRENT_PERM_MB as decimal(38,2)
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	format: 'parquet') ~> OLEDBSource
source(output(
		sandbox_name as string,
		platform_name as string,
		environment_name as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	format: 'parquet') ~> LookupLKPTABLE
OLEDBSource, LookupLKPTABLE lookup(ENVRN_TXT == environment_name
	&& DATABASENAME == sandbox_name,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'auto')~> Lookup
Lookup filter(isMatch()) ~> Lookup0
Lookup0 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	format: 'parquet',
	partitionFileNames:[($OutFileName)],
	saveOrder: 10000,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
